name: Omarchy Lacquer
author: deunnis
description: One app for how your Omarchy desktop looks. Themes, wallpapers, theme shuffle and aether generation with a readability check; saved looks you can name and carry to another machine; fonts, text rendering, GTK, icons and the mouse pointer; window shape, border gradients built from your theme, glass, shadow and the colour behind your windows; one motion feel for the whole desktop, or every animation and bezier on its own; sizes, screens and night light; lock, boot and screensaver; shell style, bar and menu look; per-app window rules and launcher entries; terminals, btop, prompt and every plugin's settings. 370 settings in everyday words, live, through the tools that already own each one.
